title: Students detained protesting near Election Commission in Bengaluru

tea.why: Protesting against alleged irregularities in the SIR of electoral rolls.
tea.want: Demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and election reform.
tea.changed: Oct 10: Police detained 125 leftist student demonstrators near the Election Commission office in Bengaluru.

summary: Members of student organisations gathered in Bengaluru to march towards the Election Commission office to demonstrate against alleged irregularities in the SIR of electoral rolls. The participants demanded election reforms and the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. According to reports, police intervened and detained 125 leftist student protesters during the demonstration.
demands: Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
response: According to the sources, police intervened and detained 125 student protesters who attempted to march towards the Election Commission office.

updates.text: Student organisation members attempted to march towards the Election Commission office in Bengaluru.
Police detained 125 student demonstrators demanding election reform and the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner.
